blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Robots that store past experiences must select which one to reuse in a new scene. Most systems select by visual similarity, and most evaluations report only the success of the selected experience. That number does not show whether the selection was good: a rule can score well by repeatedly using one broadly transferable experience, or poorly because its preferred experience is weak. This matters because robots increasingly adapt by reuse rather than retraining: every such adaptation passes through this selection step, and a score that describes the library rather than the rule misleads what the field builds next. We contribute an audit methodology: execute every stored experience in every query scene, yielding the complete table of transfer outcomes, over two manipulation tasks, three reuse mechanisms, and libraries of K = 3 K=3 , 10 10 , and 50 50 . The complete table is what makes the confound measurable: every alternative’s outcome is known, so a score can be traced to per-scene selection or to library quality. The audited rules select by nearest-neighbor distance in five visual embeddings, from raw pixels to CLIP. We see four results. (1) One fixed experience, chosen with hindsight, captures 30–58% of the gap between random selection and an oracle; per-scene selection competes for the remaining 0.07–0.15 in success rate. (2) At K ≥ 10 K\geq 10 , visual rules concentrate on one experience 1.5–3 times more than the oracle does, and their scores then follow that experience’s quality. (3) Wherever a rule differs significantly from a shuffle that keeps its selection rates but pairs them with scenes at random, the rule is worse, for every learned image policy. (4) Visual distance predicts well whether a given pair will succeed (AUROC up to 0.96), yet ranks the candidates within one scene no better than chance for four of five embeddings at K = 50 K=50 (AUROC 0.45–0.52). Exhaustive execution is usually infeasible, so the audit reduces to two cheap reports any study can give: the distribution of selected experiences, and the success of the best single experience in hindsight.
blocks.zh: 存储过去经验的机器人必须选择在新场景中重新使用哪一个. 大多数系统通过视觉相似性选择,大多数评价只报告所选经验的成功. 这个数字没有显示选择是否良好:规则可以通过反复使用一种广泛可转让的经验来得分良好,或者因为其偏好的经验很弱而差。 这一点很重要,因为机器人越来越多地通过再利用而不是再培训来适应:每一次这样的适应都经过这个选择步骤,一个描述库而不是规则的分数会误导接下来的领域建设. 我们提供一个审计方法:在每个查询场景中执行每一个存储的经验,得出完整的传输结果表,完成两个操纵任务,三个再利用机制,以及K=3K=3、10个10个和50个库。 完整的表格是让困惑者可以衡量的:每个选择的结果都已经知道,所以一个分数可以追溯到每个场景的选择或者图书馆的质量. 经审计的规则由近邻相距以5个视觉嵌入方式选择,从原始像素到CLIP. 我们看到四个结果。 (1)一个固定的经验,用后视法选择,捕捉随机选择和甲骨文之间的差距的30-58%;每个场景选择竞争剩下的0.07-0.15成功率. (2) 在K 10 K\geq 10中,视觉规则集中在一个比甲骨文高出1.5至3倍的经验上,然后他们的分数跟随这种经验的质量。 (3) 凡规则与保持其选择率但随机与场景相配的洗牌大相径庭时,规则就更差了,因为每个学习到的图像政策. (4)视觉距离能很好地预测一对选手是否会成功(AUROC可达0.96分),然而在K=50K=50分(AUROC 0.45-0.52分)的5个嵌入中4个选手将考生排在一个场景中不胜枚举. 穷尽处决通常不可行,因此审计将任何研究所能提供的两个廉价报告:一些经验的分布,以及最佳单一经验在后视的成功.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Robots increasingly store demonstrations, trajectories, and policies for reuse. Reuse is becoming how robots adapt in deployment: a retrieved demonstration seeds few-shot imitation, a similar past episode conditions a policy, a stored skill is executed directly. Each of these passes through one selection step. Given a new scene, the robot must select which stored experience to use. A common rule is nearest-neighbor retrieval: embed the current scene, embed each stored scene, and select the experience whose stored scene is closest [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . The rule assumes that visually similar scenes call for the same experience.
blocks.zh: 机器人越来越多地储存演示、轨迹和再利用政策。 重新使用正在成为机器人在部署中如何适应:一个被检索到的演示种子几发相仿,一个类似的过去插曲条件一个政策,一个被存储的技能直接被执行. 每一个都经过一个甄选步骤。 鉴于新的场景,机器人必须选择使用哪些存储的经验. 一个通则是近邻取回:嵌入当前场景,嵌入每个被存储场景,并选择存储场景距离最近的体验 [1,2,3]. 规则假设视觉相似的场景需要同样的经验.

blocks.en: We study how to evaluate this selection. For a query scene q q and a stored experience e i e_{i} , define the transfer probability T ⁡ ( i , q ) = P ⁡ ( success ∣ e i , q ) . T(i,q)=P(\mathrm{success}\mid e_{i},q). (1) An ideal retriever selects arg ⁡ max i ​ T ​ ( i , q ) \arg\max_{i}T(i,q) . A similarity rule instead selects arg ⁡ min i ⁡ d ⁡ ( f ⁡ ( q ) , f ⁡ ( e i ) ) \arg\min_{i}d(f(q),f(e_{i})) , where f f is an embedding and d d a distance. The audit asks how well the second quantity approximates the first.
blocks.zh: 我们研究如何评估这一选择。 对于一个查询场景 q 和存储的经验 e i e i i i },定义传输概率 T → (i, q ) = P → (成功 → i , q ). T (i, q) = P (\ mathrm{ success}\mid e_{i},q). (1) 一个理想的检索器选择了 arg 最大 i T (i, q )\arg\max i} T (i, q ) 。 相似性规则则选择了 arg ⁡ min i ⁡ d ⁡ (f ⁡ (q ), f ⁡ (e i))\arg\ min_{i}d (f (q),f (e_{i)) ),其中 f 为嵌入式和 d 为相距. 审计询问第二个数量与第一个数量相近的程度。

blocks.en: Standard evaluations execute only the selected experience and report its success. This number mixes two things: the quality of the decision and the quality of the library. A rule can score well by always selecting one strong experience. A rule can score poorly because it keeps selecting one weak experience. In both cases the score describes an experience, not the rule.
blocks.zh: 标准评价只执行所选经验并报告其成功情况。 这个数字混合了两件事:决定的质量和图书馆的质量. 规则总是通过选择一个强的经验来得分。 一条规则可能得分差,因为它总是选择一个弱的经验. 在这两种情况下,得分都描述了经验,而不是规则。

blocks.en: We therefore ask a methodological question: how can we audit whether a robot retriever actually chose well? Our answer is to measure the alternatives. In simulation, we execute every stored experience in every query scene. This yields the complete transfer matrix of outcomes, which no ordinary deployment can observe. We also vary scene appearance (lighting, colour, texture, camera pose) independently of scene layout (object poses, articulation, obstacles). The physics is identical across appearance changes, so appearance effects and layout effects can be separated.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们提出一个方法问题:我们如何审计一个机器人检索器是否真正选择得当? 我们的答案是衡量替代办法。 在模拟中,我们执行每个查询场景中存储的每一个经验. 这就产生了完整的转移结果矩阵,没有正常的部署能够观察到。 我们还将场景外观(灯光、颜色、纹理、相机姿势)与场景布局(物体姿势、表达、障碍)分开。 物理学在外观变化之间是相同的,因此外观效果和布局效果可以分离.

blocks.en: The audit has one central finding. Predicting transfer and selecting an experience are different problems. Visual distance predicts well whether a given experience-scene pair will succeed. It ranks poorly which of the K K candidates to use for a given scene. The reason is that most of the outcome variance is shared within a scene: a hard scene is hard for every candidate. A score can detect hard scenes and still not separate the candidates. This one distinction explains three observations that would otherwise conflict: visual rules concentrate on few experiences, equalizing library quality restores positive discrimination, and high pooled prediction accuracy coexists with negative selection value.
blocks.zh: 审计有一个中心结论。 预测转移和选择经验是不同的问题。 视觉相距能很好地预测给定的经验-场景配对是否会成功. 它给KK选手中的哪一个选手 分配的分级很差 原因是大部分结果差异都是在一个场景内分享的:对每个候选人来说,硬场是很难的. 一个分数可以检测出硬场景,仍然不能将考生分开. 这一区分解释了三种否则会相冲突的看法:视觉规则集中在很少的经验上,均衡的图书馆质量恢复了积极的区别对待,高度集合的预测准确性与负面的选择价值并存.

blocks.en: The contribution is methodological. We propose no new retrieval method, and we claim no general verdict on visual similarity. We propose a way to measure whether a retriever chose well, and we show that this measurement changes the conclusions an ordinary evaluation would draw, including several of our own.
blocks.zh: 贡献在于方法。 我们没有提出新的检索方法,我们声称没有关于视觉相似性的一般判决。 我们提出一种方法来衡量一个检索器是否选择的很好,我们表明,这种衡量方法改变了一个普通评价得出的结论,包括我们自己的几个结论。

blocks.en:
Contributions. (1) An audit protocol that scores retrieval against the complete transfer matrix, not only the selected trajectory.
(2) Direct measurements separating pooled transfer prediction from within-query ranking, showing that the first does not imply the second.
(3) Controls that isolate the effect of library composition: an oracle concentration reference, a best-fixed reference, frequency-matched shuffles, random sub-libraries, and quality-equalized libraries.
(4) A directional result for learned image policies: whenever visual selection differs significantly from the frequency-matched baseline, it is worse.
(5) Two reporting diagnostics for ordinary studies: the selection distribution and the best-fixed reference.
blocks.zh:
捐款。 (1) 审计协议,根据完整的转移矩阵,而不仅仅是选定的轨迹,对检索进行评分。
(2)直接测量将集合转移预测与平分内部的排名区分开来,表明第一种并不意味着第二种.
(3)隔离库组成效果的控制:甲骨文集中参考,最固定的参考,频率相匹配的洗牌,随机子图书馆,质量等同的库.
(4)学习成像政策的方向性结果:每当视觉选择与频率比对基线有显著差异时,情况会更糟.
(5)普通研究的两个报告诊断:选择分布和最固定的参考.

blocks.en: II Audit protocol
blocks.zh: 二. 审计协议

blocks.en: Tasks and scenes. We use Stack and Door in robosuite [ 4 ] with a Panda arm under pose control. A scripted expert records each stored experience in its own base scene. Each query set contains 40 physical states. The states span four layout levels: object displacement up to ± 12 \pm 12 cm, relative displacement or articulation, and obstacles. Each state is rendered under five appearance draws. Appearance draws change lighting, colour, texture, and small camera rotations. They do not change physics: the simulator state hash is identical across the five renders of each layout.
blocks.zh: 任务与场景. 我们用Stack和Door 在robosoite [4] 与熊猫手臂处于控制。 一名被脚本化的专家记录了各自存储在自己基地场景中的经验. 每个查询集包含40个物理状态. 这些州跨越四个布局级别:物体迁移至± 12\pm 12cm;相对迁移或布局;障碍。 每个状态由五个外观图画制成。 外观绘制了变化的照明,颜色,纹理,以及小型相机旋转. 它们不会改变物理:模拟态散列在每块布局的五分之一。

blocks.en: Reuse mechanisms. We evaluate three ways to reuse an experience. Replay retargets the recorded end-effector path to the current object poses and executes it open-loop [ 5 ] . Replay never reads the camera, so appearance cannot affect it. This is confirmed in the data: 0 of 600 labelled cases change across renders. Policy trains one behavior-cloned image policy per experience (BC-RNN [ 6 ] ). Both appearance and layout affect a Policy execution. Policy+DR trains the same policy class with randomized lighting and texture. On Stack, this reduces the share of failures caused by appearance from 26% to 2%, and layout-caused failures remain matched pair by pair. On Door, domain randomization degrades layout performance by a measured amount.
blocks.zh: 复用机制. 我们评价三种方式来重复经验。 重放已记录的端效道重新瞄准当前对象所显示的端效道并执行开放-loop [5]. 重放从不读取相机,所以外观不会影响相机. 数据证实了这一点:在600起标注的个案中,零起因情况变化而改变。 政策对每个经验进行一项行为克隆图像政策(BC-RNN [6]. 外观和布局都影响到政策的执行。 Politicle+DR 以随机照明和纹理进行同一类政策培训. 在Stack上,这可以将外观导致的故障比例从26%降低到2%,而布局导致的故障仍然相配成对. 在Door上,域随机化会将布局性能降低到一个被测量的量.

blocks.en: Ground truth. We execute every pair ( e i , q ) (e_{i},q) with five seeds and record the success rate y i ​ q y_{iq} . The result is an answer that ordinary deployment cannot see: for each scene, the outcome of the selected experience, of every experience not selected, of random selection, and of oracle selection. The study uses 114,500 114{,}500 seeded executions plus 250 own-base replays. The unit of analysis is the transfer matrix, not the execution count.
blocks.zh: 事实真相 我们用5个种子执行每对(e i, q (e_{i}i},q)),并记录成功率y i q y_{iq}. 结果是普通部署无法看到的答案:对于每个场景,选取经验的结果,没有选取的每一个经验的结果,随机选择的结果,以及甲骨文选择的结果. 该研究使用了114,500 114{,}500起种子处决外加250起自制回放. 分析的单位是转移矩阵,而不是执行计数.

blocks.en: Selection rules. We test nearest-neighbor retrieval in five embeddings: raw 32 × 32 32\times 32 pixels, ImageNet ResNet-18, DINOv2 [ 7 ] , CLIP [ 8 ] , and the Policy+DR visual encoder. We also test recency and two structural scores: object-position proximity and path clearance. Finally, a track-record rule ranks experiences by their outcomes on past scenes. Track record uses outcome data that a zero-shot visual rule does not have. We use it only as a reference for how quickly outcome data can find a strong experience.
blocks.zh: 选拔规则。 我们用五个嵌入式测试最近的邻居检索: 生于32×32 32\times 32像素, ImageNet ResNet-18, DINov2 [7], CLIP [8], 和 Policy+DR 视觉编码器. 我们还测试惯用性和两个结构分数:物体位置相近和道路清除。 最后,根据以往的场景对经验进行记录。 音轨记录使用一个零发视觉规则没有的结果数据. 我们仅将其作为参考,说明结果数据能如何迅速找到丰富的经验。

blocks.en: Metrics. We report three quantities. First, the normalized advantage A = S rule − S random S oracle − S random , A=\frac{S_{\mathrm{rule}}-S_{\mathrm{random}}}{S_{\mathrm{oracle}}-S_{\mathrm{random}}}, (2) where S S is mean success: A = 0 A{=}0 matches random selection and A = 1 A{=}1 matches the oracle. Second, raw success rates. Third, the discrimination gap . To compute it, we generate 2,000 shuffled rules. Each shuffled rule selects each experience exactly as often as the real rule, but assigns those selections to scenes at random. The gap is the real rule’s success minus the mean shuffled success. A positive gap means the rule’s scene assignment adds value beyond its selection frequencies. Intervals are clustered by scene ( n = 40 n{=}40 ). We omit A A when its denominator falls below a threshold fixed in advance.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 我们报告3个数量。 首先,正态优势 A = S 规则 - S 随机 S oracle - S 随机 A = frac { s _{\mathrm {rule}}- S_{\mathrm {random}}}{-S_{\mathrm {oracle}}-S_{\mathrm {random}}}; (2) S S为平均成功:A=0 A{=}0匹配随机选择,A=1 A{=}1匹配甲骨文. 第二,原始成功率。 第三,歧视差距。 为了计算它,我们产生2000个被洗劫的规则。 每个被洗牌的规则选择每个体验的频率与真正的规则相同,但将这些选择随机指定给场景. 差距是实际规则的成功, 正面差距意味着规则的场景分配会增加其选择频率以外的价值。 间距按场景组合(n = 40 n{=}40) 。 当A分母低于预先确定的阈值时,我们省略了 A 。

blocks.en: III How much can selection add?
blocks.zh: 页:1 选择可以增加多少?

blocks.en: Selection matters only if different scenes need different experiences. We first measure how much room the benchmark leaves for this.
blocks.zh: 只有在不同的场景需要不同的经验时,选择才有意义. 我们首先衡量基准在这方面留下的空间。

blocks.en: Define best-fixed as the single experience with the highest mean success on the query set, chosen after seeing all outcomes. Best-fixed uses no per-scene information. It is not a deployable method; it is a reference.
blocks.zh: 在看到所有结果后选择,将最佳固定定义为在查询集中平均成功率最高的单个体验. 最佳固定使用不使用每个场景的信息. 这不是一种可部署的方法;它是一种参考。

blocks.en: Best-fixed is strong (Table I ). It captures 30–58% of the gap between random and oracle selection in every stable setting; in the advantage metric, A = 0.30 A=0.30 – 0.58 0.58 (Table I ). No tested rule beats it with non-overlapping intervals, and point excesses are at most 0.04. The intervals are wide, so the correct conclusion is that no rule is distinguishable from best-fixed, not that all rules equal it.
blocks.zh: 最佳固定型很强(表一)。 它捕捉每个稳定环境下随机选择和甲骨文选择之间的差距的30–58%;在优势度量衡中,A=0.30 A=0.30–0.58 0.58(表一). 没有经过测试的规则用不重叠的间隔来击败它,而点过分最多为0.04. 间隔很广,所以正确的结论是,任何规则都不能与最固定的规则区分开来,而不是所有规则都平等.

blocks.en: The headroom above best-fixed is small (Table I , headroom column). The oracle exceeds best-fixed by only 0.07–0.15 in success rate, in every stable setting. The headroom does not grow with library size: at K = 50 K{=}50 it is 0.130, below our advance prediction of at least 0.15. The conclusion is direct. In these libraries, the main opportunity is not to match experiences to scenes. It is to find the experiences that transfer broadly. Section VI shows the same fact from the variance side.
blocks.zh: 顶端最整齐的房顶为小(表一,房顶栏). 甲骨文在每平稳的环境下,成功率仅超过最佳定律0.07-0.15. 头室不会随着图书馆的大小而扩大:在K=50K{=}50时,它比我们预估的至少0.15时低0.130分. 结论是直接的。 在这些图书馆里,主要的机会是不把经验与场景相匹配. 它就是要找到广泛转让的经验。 第六节从差异方可以看出同样的事实。

blocks.en: TABLE I: Best-fixed advantage, oracle and random success, headroom (oracle minus best-fixed success), and the oracle’s top-pick share (the concentration reference of Sec. IV ).
blocks.zh: 表格 I:最佳固定优势,甲骨文和随机成功,头室(甲骨文减去最佳固定成功),甲骨文的首选份额(Sec. IV的集中参考).

blocks.en: Outcome data finds strong experiences quickly. The track-record rule selects the best or second-best experience in every set, and it locks onto a strong experience after about six scenes. On fresh image-policy scenes it matches or beats every visual rule in the warm-start setting. At K = 50 K{=}50 it still trails best-fixed ( A = 0.26 A{=}0.26 versus 0.51 0.51 ): estimating 50 candidates from 40 scenes has an exploration cost. Track record is not a fair competitor to visual retrieval, because it sees outcomes. Its role here is to show that a little outcome data identifies the quantity that matters most, the mean success of each experience.
blocks.zh: 结果数据发现经验很快。 音轨录制规则在每个集中选择最佳或第二好的经验,它锁定在大约六个场景之后的强经验上. 在新鲜的图像政策场景中,它匹配或击败了温暖起动设定中的每一个视觉规则. K = 50 K = 5 = 50 仍为最佳固定(A = 0.26 A = 0.26 A = 0.51 0.51):估计40个场景的50名候选人有勘探费用。 追踪记录对于视觉检索来说不是一个公平的竞争者,因为它看到了结果. 它的作用是表明,一个小的结果数据可以确定最重要的数量,即每种经验的平均成功。

blocks.en: IV Concentration: the score follows the top pick
blocks.zh: 四、结 论 浓度: 得分跟随上接点

blocks.en: Visual rules keep selecting the same experience. We call the experience a rule selects most often its top pick . This section measures how concentrated the rules are, and what the top pick does to the score.
blocks.zh: 视觉规则继续选择相同的体验. 我们把经验称为规则, 本节衡量规则的集中程度,以及上取法对分数的影响.

blocks.en: Concentration must be compared to the right reference. The oracle itself is concentrated, because several experiences often tie for the best outcome. The oracle’s top-pick share is 0.38–0.52 at K = 3 K{=}3 , 0.20 at K = 10 K{=}10 , and 0.10 at K = 50 K{=}50 (Table I , last column). The visual rules’ top-pick share is 0.50–0.68 in several K = 3 K{=}3 settings, 0.30–0.60 at K = 10 K{=}10 , and 0.25–0.30 at K = 50 K{=}50 . Against the oracle reference, the excess at K = 3 K{=}3 is small and often absent. At K ≥ 10 K\geq 10 it is clear: visual rules are 1.5–3 times as concentrated as the oracle (Fig. 3 , left).
blocks.zh: 必须把浓度与正确的参考相比较。 先知本身是集中的,因为若干经验往往与最佳结果挂钩。 甲骨文的首选份额为:K=3K{=}3;K=10K{=}10;K=50K{=}50;0.10;表一,最后一栏。 视觉规则的首选份额是:K=3个KQQ3设置的0.50–0.68;K=10个KQ10的0.30–0.60;K=50个KQX50的0.25–0.30。 与"甲骨文"的参考文献相反,K = 3 K = 3 K = 3的多余部分很小,而且经常缺席. 在K- 10 K\ geq 10 中, 很明显: 视觉规则是甲骨文的1.5至3倍(图3, 左)。

blocks.en: Concentration is costly when the top pick is weak. Define the quality margin of an experience as its mean success minus the library mean. If a score merely follows the top pick, the sign of the advantage A A should match the sign of the top pick’s margin: a strong top pick gives A > 0 A>0 , a weak one gives A < 0 A<0 . We tested this across the whole benchmark. A setting is one combination of task, reuse mechanism, and library; 13 settings have a denominator large enough to report A A (Sec. II ). Seven rules report A A in each of them: the five visual embeddings and the two structural scores. That gives 7 × 13 = 91 7\times 13=91 cases. The signs match in 69 of the 91. The policy encoder is the clearest example (Table II ). Its advantage is negative when its top pick is weak, positive when its top pick is strong, and negative again at K = 50 K{=}50 , where its top pick is the weakest experience in the library. We predicted the signs of the two K = 10 K{=}10 rows in advance, from the top pick’s quality alone. The pattern is not a law. Raw pixels at K = 10 K{=}10 are a counterexample: their top pick is weak, yet they select it mainly on the scenes where it works.
blocks.zh: 当顶部选取力弱时,浓度成本很高. 定义一个经验的质量边距,作为它的平均成功率减去库的平均值。 如果一个分数只是跟随上位取而代之,则优势A的标志应该与上位取而代之:强上位取而代之的是A. > 0 A>0,弱者给A < 0 A<0. 我们测试了整个基准。 一个设置是任务,再利用机制,和库的一个组合;13个设置具有足够大的分母,可以报告AA(Sec. II.). 7个规则分别报告AA:五个视觉嵌入和两个结构分数. 也就是说,7×13=91 7\时13=91个病例。 标志与91分中的69分相匹配. 政策编码器是最明显的例子(表二)。 它的优势是当它的上取力弱时是负的,当它的上取力强时是正的,在K=50K{=}50时又是负的,它的上取力是库中最弱的经验. 我们预言两K=10KXX10行的预兆, 规律非一法相. K = 10 K = 10 K = 10 的原始像素是一个反例:它们的顶取力很弱,然而它们却主要在它工作的场景中选择.

blocks.en: TABLE II: The policy encoder on Stack Replay. Its advantage follows the quality of its top pick.
blocks.zh: 表格 二: Stack Replay上的政策编码器. 它的优势跟随其顶级选手的质量.

blocks.en: Does a rule’s scene assignment add anything beyond its frequencies? The discrimination gap answers this. Figure 1 shows each visual rule’s gap with the 95% envelope of its frequency-matched shuffles. In 42 of 65 cases, the rule lies inside the envelope. This does not prove those rules are equivalent to frequency-matched random assignment. With 40 scenes the envelope is wide, and we have not measured its power to detect small gaps. It shows compatibility, nothing stronger.
blocks.zh: 一个规则的场景任务会增加频率以外的东西吗? 歧视差距就解决了这个问题。 图1显示每个视觉规则与95%的频率相匹配的收发信封的差距。 在65个案件中,42个案件的规则在信封内。 这不能证明这些规则等同于频率匹配的随机分配。 有了40个场景,信封是宽的,我们还没有测量它探测出小缺口的能力. 它显示兼容性,没有什么更强大。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Discrimination gap versus top-pick share for the visual rules. Error bars show the 95% envelope of frequency-matched shuffles. Red points lie outside the envelope. The gap shows no clear relation to concentration: concentration measures how often a rule repeats its top pick, not whether its scene assignment helps.
blocks.zh: 发相. 1:视觉规则的歧视差距与首选份额。 出错栏显示95%的频率匹配洗牌信封. 红色点位于信封外。 空隙显示与集中没有明确的关系:集中度量规则多经常重复其上接取,而不是其场景分配是否有帮助.

blocks.en: The cases outside the envelope are the informative ones. Under Replay, nine are positive and two are negative. So visual assignment can add per-scene value even when selections are concentrated. Under the learned image policies, the result is one-directional: all twelve significant Policy and Policy+DR cases lie below the envelope . For these policies, similarity assigns the selections to the wrong scenes. Holding the frequencies fixed, random assignment would have scored higher.
blocks.zh: 信封外的案件是资料性的案件。 在回放下,有9个是正数,有2个是负数. 因此,即使选择集中,视觉任务也可以增加人均值. 根据学习到的形象政策,结果是单向的:所有12个重要政策和政策+ DR病例在信封下方 对于这些政策,相似性将选择分配到错误的场景. 保持频率固定,随机分配会得分更高。

blocks.en: Why would similarity assign scenes wrongly? The appearance/layout design suggests an answer. Image policies fail under appearance changes. Generic encoders mostly measure appearance. So a similarity score can flag which scenes are hard, without saying which stored policy is safest there. We fixed a test of this in advance: recompute the gap separately on appearance-perturbed scenes and on layout-perturbed scenes, for the twelve significant cases. The negative gap is larger on the appearance side in 9 of 12 cases. The three exceptions are the fresh-scene Door Policy+DR cases, where the smaller layout subsets ( n = 30 n{=}30 ) carry the larger negative gap with wide intervals. The mechanism holds for most cases, not all.
blocks.zh: 为什么相似性会错误地分配场景? 外观/外观设计给出了一个答案. 图像政策在外观变化下失败. 通用编码器主要测量外观. 因此,一个相似的分数可以标出哪些场景是硬的,而不说哪些存储的政策是安全的。 我们事先对此做了一个测试:对12个重要案例的外观扰动场景和布局扰动场景分别重新计算空隙. 在12个案例中,9个案件中的外观差距较大。 三种例外是新鲜-场景 Door Policy+DR案例,其中较小的布局子集(n = 30 n{=}30)所承载的负差较大,间隔很广. 该机制对大多数案件,而不是所有案件都适用。

blocks.en: V The library changes what the score means
blocks.zh: 五、结 论 图书馆改变分数的意思

blocks.en: The same rule gets different scores in different libraries. This section measures that dependence with three label-informed procedures. All three are measurement tools, not methods: each uses outcome data that a deployed retriever would not have. Estimating experience quality without exhaustive labels remains open.
blocks.zh: 同一规则在不同图书馆获得不同的分数. 本节衡量依赖三种有标签的程序。 这三种都是测量工具,而不是方法:每种方法都使用部署的检索器不会得到的结果数据。 在没有详尽标签的情况下对经验质量进行估计,仍然开放。

blocks.en: Equalize the library. We build sub-libraries whose experiences have nearly equal mean success. Labels choose the sub-library; the rule never sees them. At K = 10 K{=}10 , equalization uncovers discrimination that unequal libraries hide. Four of five visual rules become positive, with top-pick quality margins near zero; the policy encoder stays negative (Table III , top). The same rules score 0.12–0.21 lower in the unequal libraries. At K = 3 K{=}3 , the equalized advantages are near zero. We do not conclude that equalization removes the signal there: A A is unstable when its denominator is small, and we could not confirm the denominator in those sets. The supported statement is narrower. At K = 10 K{=}10 , real discrimination survives once library quality is equalized.
blocks.zh: 平分库. 我们建立了子图书馆,其经验几乎是同等的成功。 标签选择子图书馆;规则从未看到它们. 在K = 10 K = 10,平等揭示了不平等图书馆所隐藏的歧视。 5个视觉规则中有4个成为正数,上接点质量差值接近0;政策编码器保持负数(表三,上接点). 同样的规则在不平等的图书馆中得分更低. 0.12–0.21. 在K=3KQQ3时,等分优势接近于零. 我们并不认为平等消除了那里的信号:A在分母小时是不稳定的,我们无法确认这些分母。 支持的语句较窄. K = 10 K = 10, 图书馆质量均衡后, 真正的歧视依然存在。

blocks.zh: 表格 三:发言对好处的影响 等同和删除使用标签;它们是诊断而不是方法.

blocks.en: Re-rank the scores. Hubness corrections adjust similarity scores to reduce the dominance of frequent nearest neighbors [ 9 ] . Untuned CSLS [ 10 ] and mutual proximity [ 11 ] barely move the results (Table III , middle). Their effect is smaller than the effect of equalizing the library.
blocks.zh: 重排分数. Hubness校正会调整相近分数,以降低频繁相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相的分等相近相近相近相近相差相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相的分等相近相近相差相近相近相近相近相近相近相近相的分相差相差相差相差相差相相差相 未调整的 CSLS [10] 和相邻 [11] 勉强移动结果(表 三,中段). 它们的效果比平分库的效果要小.

blocks.en: Delete the top pick. Removing one experience, the rule’s top pick, flips two rules from negative to positive at K = 50 K{=}50 (Table III , bottom). Deletion uses labels, so it is not a method. But it locates the failure. The failure lives in the pairing of a concentrated rule with one weak experience. It is not a geometric artifact that re-ranking can fix.
blocks.zh: 删除顶取. 取消一个经验, 规则的顶级选择, 删除使用标签,所以这不是一种方法。 但是它能定位失败 失败存在于一个集中的规则与一个弱的经验的配对中. 它不是一个几何级数的文物 可以重新排列。

blocks.en: Local success does not imply transfer. Figure 2 shows a library problem that exists before any retrieval. Of the 50 Replay experiences, 49 repeat their own base scene with success at least 0.8 (mean 0.92). Yet own-base success does not predict cross-scene success: the correlation is ρ = − 0.04 \rho{=}-0.04 . Seven experiences are reliable at home (own-base ≥ 0.8 \geq 0.8 ) and weak elsewhere (cross-scene ≤ 0.45 \leq 0.45 ). The standard acceptance test for a demonstration asks whether it works where it was collected. That test does not measure what reuse depends on, which is how well the demonstration transfers.
blocks.zh: 当地的成功并不意味着转移。 图2显示在任何检索之前就存在的图书馆问题。 50回放体验中,有49回回放他们自己的基地场景,成功率至少为0.8(平均值为0.92). 然而,基于自身基础的成功并不能预测到交叉场景的成功:相关性= ^ 0.04\rho=- 0.04。 7次经验在国内是可靠的(自有基地为0.8\geq 0.8),在其他地方是薄弱的(横场为0.45\leq 0.45)。 示范的标准验收标准问其采集地点是否有效. 这一测试不能衡量再利用取决于什么,也就是示范转让情况如何。

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Own-base success versus mean cross-scene success for the 50 Replay experiences. The two are uncorrelated ( ρ = − 0.04 \rho=-0.04 ). Seven experiences have own-base success ≥ 0.8 \geq 0.8 and cross-scene success ≤ 0.45 \leq 0.45 .
blocks.zh: 发相. 2: 自主基础成功对50回放体验的跨场取胜. 两者互不相干(^ ^ 0.04\rho=-0.04). 7个经验有自己基础的成功 0.8\geq 0.8和交叉基础的成功 0.45\leq 0.45。

blocks.en: VI Predicting transfer is not ranking candidates
blocks.zh: 六. 预测调动不是排行榜候选人

blocks.en: The results so far pose a question. If visual selection is weak, does visual distance carry no information? It carries a lot. This section shows where the information goes.
blocks.zh: 迄今为止的结果提出了一个问题。 如果视觉选择薄弱,视觉距离是否没有信息? 载之甚多. 本节列出信息去向.

blocks.en: We treat the negated distance − d ⁡ ( f ⁡ ( q ) , f ⁡ ( e i ) ) -d(f(q),f(e_{i})) as a score for whether the pair ( e i , q ) (e_{i},q) succeeds, and we measure the area under the ROC curve (AUROC). AUROC is the probability that a random successful pair gets a smaller distance than a random failed pair: 0.5 is chance, 1 is perfect. Pooled over all pairs, the prediction is good for image policies: AUROC reaches 0.85–0.96 under appearance perturbations and 0.70–0.91 under layout perturbations (see also Table IV ). Replay values are lower, as its causal structure requires: appearance cannot affect an open-loop replay.

blocks.en: Pooled AUROC is not selection accuracy. The reason is a decomposition: T ⁡ ( i , q ) = g ⁡ ( q ) ⏟ scene difficulty + h ⁡ ( i , q ) ⏟ candidate-specific + ϵ . T(i,q)=\underbrace{g(q)}_{\text{scene difficulty}}+\underbrace{h(i,q)}_{\text{candidate-specific}}+\epsilon. (3) A hard scene lowers T T for every candidate at once. A score that tracks g ⁡ ( q ) g(q) predicts many pair outcomes correctly. But selection never compares across scenes. Selection compares the K K candidates within one scene, and for that only h ⁡ ( i , q ) h(i,q) matters.
blocks.zh: 集合的 AUROC 不是选择的精度 。 原因是分解: T → (i, q) = g → (q) 场景难度 + h → (i, q) + = 候选人特异性 + . T (i, q) + underbrace{g(q) + 文本特异性 → (i, q) → scene didate- special → epsilon. (3)一出硬场,每名候选人一出就降低T T. 跟踪 g Q (q) g(q) 的分数可以正确预测许多对结果 。 但是,选择从来不比 跨场景。 选取比较一个场景中的K K候选人,为此只涉及h-(i,q) h(i,q).

blocks.en: So we measure ranking within the scene: for each scene q q , whether − d ⁡ ( f ⁡ ( q ) , f ⁡ ( e i ) ) -d(f(q),f(e_{i})) ranks T ⁡ ( i , q ) T(i,q) across the K K candidates. For each scene, candidates with y ≥ 0.8 y\geq 0.8 are positives and y ≤ 0.2 y\leq 0.2 are negatives; scenes without both are excluded; per-scene AUROC is averaged with scene-clustered intervals. We fixed this rule in advance and recomputed pooled AUROC with the same labels for comparison. The result is consistent (Table IV ): within-query AUROC is below pooled AUROC in 62 of 65 eligible cases . The gap is widest at K = 50 K{=}50 : pooled AUROC stays above 0.7, while within-query AUROC is at or near chance for every representation except ResNet. The K = 3 K{=}3 image-policy rows carry a caveat. Only 7–19% of those scenes are eligible, and with one positive and one negative a per-scene AUROC can only be 0, 1 2 \tfrac{1}{2} , or 1.

blocks.en: A variance decomposition says where the mismatch is worst. Let g ⁡ ( q ) g(q) be the mean of T ⁡ ( i , q ) T(i,q) over the K K candidates, and let R q 2 R_{q}^{2} be the share of the total variance of T T explained by g ⁡ ( q ) g(q) . Large R q 2 R_{q}^{2} means scene difficulty dominates; small R q 2 R_{q}^{2} means the candidates genuinely differ. We predicted R q 2 > 0.5 R_{q}^{2}>0.5 everywhere. The prediction failed in exactly two settings, the Stack Replay K = 3 K{=}3 sets, where R q 2 R_{q}^{2} is 0.42 and 0.45. Those are also the settings with the strongest positive visual-selection results. Everywhere else the prediction held: R q 2 R_{q}^{2} is 0.52–0.57 for Replay at K ≥ 10 K\geq 10 , and 0.71–0.81 for the image policies, exactly where all twelve significant gaps are negative. So R q 2 R_{q}^{2} varies across settings in step with where visual selection works. Our advance prediction covered only the 0.5 threshold, not this ordering, so we report the ordering as supporting evidence, not a confirmed relationship.

blocks.en: A second check agrees. ResNet is the only rule with a positive gap at every Replay library size (Sec. VII ). It is also the only representation above chance in within-query AUROC at K = 50 K{=}50 . CLIP and the policy encoder show the reverse: large advantages in magnitude at K = 50 K{=}50 ( − 0.42 -0.42 , − 0.57 -0.57 ) with within-query AUROC near 0.5. Two different summaries of the matrix single out the same representation.
blocks.zh: 第二次检查同意。 ResNet是唯一一条在每个回放库大小(Sec. VII)上出现正差的规则. CLIP和政策编码器显示相反的情况:K=50 K-50(0.42-0.42;0.57-0.57)在平地内AUROC中具有很大的优势。 汇总表的两份不同的摘要都列出了同样的表述。

blocks.en: The design target follows. A retrieval representation does not need to predict which scenes are hard. It needs to order the K K candidates within one scene by transferability. Selectors should be trained and evaluated with query-grouped ranking objectives, not only with pooled similarity.
blocks.zh: 设计目标随之而来. 检索表示不需要预测哪些场景很困难. 它需要在一个场景中通过可转移性命令KK候选人. 选择者应接受培训和评价,确定查询分组的排名目标,而不仅仅是集合式的相似性。

blocks.en: The same distinction recurs beyond retrieval. World foundation models for physical AI [ 12 ] are trained and benchmarked on prediction fidelity, while control requires the conditional analogue: ranking candidate actions or plans by outcome within a single state. Our results do not evaluate such systems, but the audit template transfers directly: pooled predictive skill should not be reported as evidence of decision-relevant ranking until the within-state statistic is measured.
blocks.zh: 同样的区别不仅限于检索。 物理AI的世界基础模型[12]在预测忠诚度方面得到训练和基准,而控制则需要有条件的模拟:将候选行动或计划按结果排列在一个州内. 我们的结果不评价这种系统,但审计模板直接转让:在计量国家内部统计数据之前,集合预测技能不应作为与决策有关的排名的证据。

blocks.zh: 页:1 库大小更改结论

blocks.en: Fig. 3: Stack Replay at K = 3 , 10 , 50 K{=}3,10,50 : top-pick share against the oracle reference, discrimination gap, and advantage against the best-fixed reference.
blocks.zh: 图3: Stack Replay at K = 3, 10, 50 K {=}3, 10, 50 :上挑分量与甲骨文参考,歧视差距,优势与最固定参考.

blocks.en: The same rule supports opposite conclusions at different library sizes (Fig. 3 ). The policy encoder’s gap is − 0.79 -0.79 at K = 3 K{=}3 , + 0.35 +0.35 and + 0.47 +0.47 at K = 10 K{=}10 , and − 0.28 -0.28 at K = 50 K{=}50 (Fig. 3 , middle). We predicted that the positive K = 10 K{=}10 gaps would persist at K = 50 K{=}50 . That held for one rule of four. ResNet is the only rule positive at all three sizes. We report that as a fact about one rule.
blocks.zh: 同一规则支持不同库大小的相反结论(图3. 政策编码器的空档为-0.79-0.79;K=3K{=}3;+0.35+0.35;+0.47+0.47;K=10K{=}10;+0.28-0.28;K=50K{=}50(图3,中). 我们预测,正K=10KXXX10差距将持续到K=50KX50。 这维持了四分之一的规则。 ResNet是所有三个尺寸的唯一规则正数. 我们报告这事实上是一个规则。

blocks.en: Two caveats limit this section. First, the nested libraries extend one recording stream, and the expert’s rejection rate changes with size (0.40, 0.33, 0.153 at K = 3 , 10 , 50 K{=}3,10,50 ). Size is therefore confounded with recording quality, and the trend is not a scaling law. Random sub-libraries address the concentration part of this concern: excess concentration appears in 96–99% of 200 random K = 10 K{=}10 compositions, with the identity of the top pick varying widely. Those sub-libraries still share one pool and one query set. Independent recording streams are the stronger test.
blocks.zh: 两项说明限制了这一节。 首先,嵌入式图书馆扩展了1个录音流,专家的拒绝率随大小变化而变化(0.40,0.33,0.153,K=3,10,50K{=}3,10,50. 因此,规模与记录质量相混淆,趋势不是缩放法. 随机子图书馆解决了这一关注的集中部分:超集中出现在200个随机K=10个KQQ10成分的96-99 %中,而顶取的特征差异很大. 这些分图书馆仍然共用一个集合和一个查询集。 独立的录音流是更强的测试.

blocks.en: Second, the size sensitivity changes how to read our small-library results. Two early conclusions at K = 3 K{=}3 did not survive at K = 10 K{=}10 : that recency beat every visual rule, and that one encoder was negatively predictive in general. All image-policy experiments here use K = 3 K{=}3 . The learned-policy results are therefore evidence about small libraries, not about scaling.
blocks.zh: 第二,体积敏感度会改变如何读取我们的小图书馆结果. K = 3 K = 3 K = 10 K = 10 K = 10 = 两项早期结论: 复调击败了每一个视觉规则,一个编码器在总体上是消极的预测. 这里所有图像政策实验都使用K=3K{=}3. 因此,学习到的政策成果证明是小型图书馆,而不是规模。

blocks.en: VIII Two reports every retrieval study can give
blocks.zh: 八 每个检索研究可以提供两份报告

blocks.en: Exhaustive execution is usually infeasible, so the methodology must reduce to cheap reports. The question a reader needs answered is simple. Does the score reflect per-scene selection, or the quality of one repeatedly selected experience? Two reports answer most of it, and any retrieval study can give them.
blocks.zh: 穷尽的处决通常是不可行的,所以方法必须降低到廉价的报告. 读者需要回答的问题很简单。 得分是反映每个场景的选择,还是一个反复选择的经验的质量? 有两份报告回答了大部分问题,任何检索研究都可以提供。

blocks.en: Report the selection distribution. State how often each experience was selected. This is free: it is a log of the evaluation the study already runs. If exhaustive labels exist, compare against the oracle’s distribution, not against uniform. Heavy concentration warns that the score may describe a few experiences.
blocks.zh: 报告选择分布。 说明选择每一经验的频率。 这是免费的: 这是研究已经运行的评价日志 。 如果存在详尽无遗的标签,则与甲骨文的分布相比较,而不是与统一标签相比较。 重集中警告,分数可能描述一些经验.

blocks.en: Report best-fixed. State the success of always using the single best experience, chosen in hindsight. This does not require the full transfer matrix. It requires only the mean success of each library item on the evaluation scenes: K K times the rollouts of the standard evaluation, with no per-scene resolution and no repeated seeds. In simulation this is routine. On hardware, a subsample of scenes per item suffices, because identifying the best item needs only rough means. Best-fixed is not a competitor. It shows how much success needed no per-scene selection at all, and how much headroom the retriever can claim.
blocks.zh: 报出最有修行. 说明在事后看来总是使用唯一最佳经验的成功。 这不需要完整的转移矩阵。 它只要求评价场景上每个库项的平均成功:K K乘以标准评价的推出,没有人均场面分辨率,没有重复的种子. 在模拟中这是例行公事。 在硬件方面,每件物品的子样本就足够了,因为确定最好的物品只需要粗糙的手段. 最佳固定不是竞争对手。 它显示需要多少成功 完全不需要每个场景的选择, 和多少头室 检索者可以要求。

blocks.en: Table V shows the current gap. In seven surveyed systems, the two reports never appear together. The two partial cases report the composition of retrieved sources, not per-item selections. This is a reporting gap, not a claim that prior results are wrong. One scope note: the two reports are defined for top-1 selection, while Behavior Retrieval, FlowRetrieval, STRAP, and arguably R+X retrieve a set of data to train on. For set retrieval the analogues are the distribution over retrieved items and training on a single hindsight-chosen subset; the entries for these systems mark reports that would need this translation, not simple omissions. Exhaustive measurement of alternatives has precedent: SRSA [ 13 ] executes every source policy on every prior task to train a transfer predictor, and reports a per-task oracle reference, in a state-based assembly setting with policy-level retrieval. It reports neither the selection distribution nor a best-fixed reference, which is the gap the two reports close.
blocks.zh: 表五显示目前的差距。 在7个接受调查的系统中,两份报告从未一起出现。 两个部分案例报告检索来源的组成,而不是逐项选择。 这是一个报告差距,而不是声称以前的结果是错误的。 一份范围说明:这两份报告被确定为第一大选择,而行为检索、流程检索、STRAP, 以及可以说RQQ检索一套数据以供培训。 套装检索的模拟数据是:在取回的物品上进行分发和对单一后视选择子集进行培训;这些系统的条目标出需要翻译的报告,而不是简单的遗漏。 对替代物进行详尽的测量是有先例的:SRSA[13]对之前的每一项任务执行每个源政策,以训练一个转移预测器,并在一个基于国家的装配环境中报告每个任务甲骨文的参考,具有政策级别的检索. 它既不报告甄选分布情况,也不报告最佳的参考,这是两份报告所弥补的差距。

blocks.en: TABLE V: Reporting audit of seven retrieval systems. Inclusion criterion: a stored demonstration, trajectory, skill, or training example is selected by an explicit rule before reuse. “Partial” means a distribution over source categories, not per-item selections.
blocks.zh: 表五:7个检索系统的报告审计。 包含标准:存储的演示,轨迹,技能,或训练实例,在再利用前由一条明确的规则选择. “部分”是指对源类别的分配,而不是对项目的选择。

blocks.en: The two reports also give a way to read any new result. A rule that spreads its selections and beats best-fixed has shown per-scene skill. A rule that concentrates and lands near best-fixed has shown that one experience is good. A rule below its frequency-matched baseline, like the image-policy cases here, is assigning its selections to the wrong scenes.
blocks.zh: 两份报告还提供了读取任何新结果的途径。 一条传播其选择和击败最佳固定规则,已经表现出了每场的技巧. 一种集中和接近最佳固定的规则表明,一种经验是好的。 其频率匹配基线以下的一条规则,就像这里的图像政策案例一样,正在将其选择分配给错误的场景.

blocks.en: Where trial history exists, the next step is practical: estimate each experience’s cross-scene quality before selecting per scene. Collection-time success is not that estimate (Fig. 2 ). Future work should pair quality estimation with query-conditional ranking, and test both on independent libraries, larger policy libraries, more tasks, and hardware. The audit template also extends beyond retrieval: any system benchmarked on prediction fidelity, including world foundation models, can be tested for the within-state ranking its decisions require.
blocks.zh: 在有审判历史的地方,下一步是实用的:在选择每个场景之前,先估计每个经验的跨场面质量. 收集时间的成功不是这一估计(图2)。 今后的工作应当将质量估计与查询-有条件的排名结合起来,并测试独立的图书馆、更大的政策图书馆、更多的任务和硬件。 审计模板也超出了检索范围:任何以预测忠诚度为基准的系统,包括世界基础模型,都可以测试其决策所需的国家内部排名。

blocks.en: IX Limitations and conclusion
blocks.zh: 九. 限制和结论

blocks.en: This is an audit of one benchmark. All K = 50 K{=}50 results use Stack under Replay. All learned-policy results use K = 3 K{=}3 , one policy class, and three policies per level. Forty scenes give wide intervals. The frequency-matched envelope has no power analysis, so the 42 of 65 count shows compatibility, not equivalence. The random sub-libraries share one recording pool and one query set. The nested libraries differ in expert rejection rate. All experiments are in simulation. The variance decomposition supports the proposed mechanism but does not confirm it, and the K = 3 K{=}3 within-query values rest on few eligible scenes.
blocks.zh: 这是对一个基准的审计。 全部K = 50 KQQ-50结果在回放下使用Stack. 所有学习政策结果使用K=3K{=}3,每级1个政策类,3个政策. 40个场景给出了宽广的间隔. 频率相匹配的信封没有动力分析,因此65个计数中的42个显示相容性,而不是等同性. 随机分图书馆共享一个记录池和一个查询集. 嵌入式图书馆在专家拒绝率上有所不同. 所有实验都在模拟中. 相差分解支持所拟议的机制,但并不确认,而K=3K{=}3入等值则停留在少数符合条件的场景上.

blocks.en: Within this scope, the conclusion is methodological. End-task success does not show whether a retriever chose well. Applying the audit overturned conclusions that ordinary evaluation had suggested, including several of our own. A representation can predict which experience-scene pairs succeed and still fail to rank the candidates for one scene. When library quality is unequal, that failure makes the score follow the rule’s top pick. At K ≥ 10 K\geq 10 , visual rules are 1.5–3 times as concentrated as the oracle, and changing the library moves scores more than re-ranking does. For learned image policies, every significant departure from the frequency-matched baseline is a departure downward.
blocks.zh: 在这一范围内,结论是方法学。 结束任务的成功并不显示一个检索器是否选择了好 。 应用审计推翻了普通评价所提出的结论,包括我们自己的若干结论。 一种表现方式可以预测哪些经验场对成功,但仍无法为某一场景对候选人进行排名. 当图书馆质量不平等时,失败使得得分遵循规则的最高选择. 在克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克 对于学习到的图像政策来说,与频率比对基线的每个重大偏离都是向下偏离。

blocks.en: The recommendation costs little and changes how retrieval results are read. Report which experiences were selected. Report best-fixed. Where counterfactual labels exist, add the frequency-matched and within-query analyses. For future methods, the target is the capability this audit measured and found missing: ranking the candidates within one scene. At K = 50 K{=}50 , visual similarity performs that ranking no better than chance (AUROC 0.45–0.52; chance is 0.5) for four of the five embeddings we tested.
blocks.zh: 该建议的成本很低,并改变了检索结果的阅读方式。 报告选定了哪些经验。 报出最有修行. 在存在反事实标签的地方,加入频率相匹配和平分内分析. 就未来的方法而言,目标是本次审计衡量和发现缺失的能力:将候选人排在一个场景内。 在K=50K{=}50时,视觉相似性表现的不胜于机会(AUROC 0.45-0.52;概率为0.5),用于我们测试的五个嵌入物中的四个.
